definitions.ask: May a phase skip a failing test or relax a CI gate when that is the only way to reach green?
definitions.why: Runner noise shouldn't block green, but deterministic failures must not be hidden

choices.label: Real fixes only; anything unfixable goes into the report and stays red
Proven flakes may be skipped, each with a flake bead; gates stay as they are
Also allows raising timeouts or dropping a job, each with a tracking task bead

definitions.ask: When downstream CI needs a release PR merged and published, who merges it?
definitions.why: Publishing can't be undone; a gate keeps you in the loop without a report round-trip

choices.label: The phase proposes the merge through /sase_gate and you approve before it publishes
The phase merges the release PR itself once its CI is green, publishing the release
The phase stops at a green release PR and lists the merge as your manual step
